items.source: Resolve the conflict for two values under the same path.
items.translation: 解决同一 `<code>path` 下两个值的冲突。

items.source:
A resolution function that is called on conflicting paths when trying to merge properties with different values
into a single value.
items.translation: 一个解析函数，在尝试将具有不同值的属性合并为单个值时，会在冲突路径上被调用。

items.source: The result after processing a conflict when merging schemas.
items.translation: 合并模式时处理冲突后的结果。

items.source: path - the MongoJsonSchema.ConflictResolutionFunction.Path leading to the conflict.
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
